mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user ( login_email, password_hash, user_name, phone_number, birth_date, user_status, user_role ) VALUES ( #{loginEmail}, #{passwordHash}, #{userName}, #{phoneNumber}, #{birthDate}, #{userStatus}, #{userRole} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, login_email, password_hash, user_name, phone_number, birth_date, user_status, created_at, updated_at, user_role FROM app_user WHERE user_id=#{userId}
SELECT user_id, login_email, password_hash, user_name, phone_number, birth_date, user_status, created_at, updated_at, user_role FROM app_user WHERE login_email=#{loginEmail} LIMIT 1
